scope: audit-only interface freeze for the generic strategy-to-research adapter; prescribes inputs/outputs and reuse proofs, not internal implementation
family_neutrality_requirements: no 'M01', no family id string, no fixed trial id in shared adapter code paths
cells enter only through configuration/plugin registration
same adapter must drive a tiny deterministic dummy strategy and the selected family plugin

strategy_registration: strategy identity/config mapping: anchor / neighbor / negative-control via config values only
immutable schedule provider returning chronological decision instants
strict-later event fills; no fill at or before decision instant
universe_and_clock: explicit universe symbol list from config
decision clock independent of bar close publication order
force-flat at scored window boundary (terminal row flat)
folds: chronological fold construction shared by all strategies
purge/embargo boundaries between train-free evaluation folds
deterministic membership: identical inputs give identical fold ids
targets_to_portfolio: daily target book -> fills/portfolio/scoring payload conversion
gross target accounting with stated tolerance
costs_and_funding: cost model injected: taker fee floor bps + adverse tick floor + optional stress multipliers
per-symbol staged funding settlements injected as PIT series
sign convention LONG_PAYS_POSITIVE_RATE; accrual only inside holding spans; no accrual before settlement publish time
symbol-native settlement cadence; uniform 8h assumption forbidden
stress: named variants minimum set: baseline, fees_x1p5, ticks_plus2, delay_plus1_event, drop_one_symbol(s), drop_one_fold(f)
each variant emits its own deterministic artifact with unique result root
benchmarks_context: flat hard benchmark: all-zero PnL series matched to cell timeline
buy-and-hold context and BTC-neutral context outputs distinct from strategy result
metrics_and_artifacts: fold metrics PF/expectancy/MDD realized after costs+ funding returns
deterministic artifact hashes over canonical serialization
provenance hashes recorded per emitted artifact
ledger_publication: exactly-once append-only trial publication keyed on preregistered trial identity
no publish when pre-score validation fails; exactly one publish after valid score
rerun of an already-published trial cannot increment the denominator again
denominator starts at historical floor 117 plus valid publications

reuse_proof_requirements: dummy deterministic strategy runs end-to-end through the same adapter entry points as the family plugin
family plugin may wrap existing module functions but must not require editing them
adapter tests parameterized across both strategies without family-specific branches in adapter code
overlap_check: pairwise file-disjoint allowlists verified by A1 before dispatch
reasons: contract freezes generic IO surface before lane integration
lanes are constrained to disjoint write sets
no scored metric produced under this contract in coding lanes
